user_request: 반투명한 사각 기둥 내부에서 빛나는 느낌
common: Edit the attached image. It is a straight-on front view of one vertical square quartz pillar seen corner-on, filling the canvas edge to edge: two flat faces meet at a sharp vertical center ridge that points toward the viewer (left face lighter gray, right face darker gray), with the two outer vertical edges at the left and right borders. This is the idle state of a long-note body texture in a vertical-scrolling rhythm game. Create the 'held / switched on' state of the SAME pillar: the pillar is a SEMI-TRANSPARENT square column and it glows from INSIDE, so the light is seen through its translucent walls. Keep exactly the same silhouette, the same left/right face division, the same center ridge position and the same outer edge positions; it must still read as the same square column seen corner-on, now translucent and lit from within. Strict rules: pure vertical stripe profile, nothing may change from top to bottom so it tiles seamlessly when stacked; no horizontal lines, bands, rings, gaps or segments; no particles, sparkles, bubbles, noise, grain, text, logos, background, perspective, vignette or top-to-bottom lighting change. Keep a neutral white, silver and gray palette unless the variant says otherwise. Readability: a bright white diamond-shaped note head will be drawn on top of this texture, so avoid large pure-white areas; the glow should read as light inside a translucent material, with the brightest parts narrow or softly diffused, and the walls should still show gray tone and depth. Polished premium game-UI material, crisp edges, not pixelated.

variants.frosted-core: Variant frosted-core: frosted translucent glass walls; a light rod runs down the central axis inside the column, and its light diffuses softly through both frosted faces as a wide soft glow centered on the ridge; the core itself is seen blurred behind the ridge; the outer edges and the ridge keep thin crisp glass highlights.
variants.frosted-fill: Variant frosted-fill: the whole interior is filled with light like a light box; both frosted faces glow fairly evenly in pale luminous gray, slightly brighter toward the ridge; thin slightly darker glass rims along the outer edges and a crisp ridge line keep the square column readable.
variants.clear-core: Variant clear-core: clearer acrylic walls with some translucency; a glowing light rod inside the column is seen more sharply behind the ridge, with soft halo and faint vertical inner reflections of the rod on both faces; the faces stay mid-tone gray with glassy depth.
variants.edge-lit: Variant edge-lit: light travels inside the translucent material and glows most strongly along the column's vertical edges (the two outer edges and the center ridge), with a soft diffused glow filling the translucent faces between them.
variants.frosted-cool: Variant frosted-cool: same as a frosted translucent column with a light rod on the central axis diffusing softly through both faces, but the internal light has a faint cool icy tint (#d8f4ff to #eefaff) only in the glow; the walls stay neutral gray.
